question: How do I work with trip comments?

sections.title: Open the trip conversation
items: Open the toolbar Trip menu and select Trips.
Select the trip you want to discuss.
Open the toolbar Trip menu again and select Comments.

sections.title: Send a new message
items: Type your message into the Write a message... field.
Plantour adds the message to the trip conversation and reloads the list.

sections.title: Read and filter the conversation
items: Each message shows the author name, the published date and time, and the message text.
Plantour displays your own messages differently from messages written by other trip members, so the conversation is easier to scan.
Use the actions bar filter to narrow the visible messages by comment text when the conversation grows longer.
